B. Is this measure already running in North Karelia wellbeing services county (or in the KYS university hospital area that treats its patients)?
A. Does recent evidence support the size of effect we assume: does this measure raise the share of lung cancer patients who get curative-intent treatment, and by how much?
Measure: Thoracic surgeon reviews every decision not to operate. A thoracic surgeon from the university hospital sits in the county lung meeting every week and gives a second opinion before a stage I-II patient is refused surgery. Counties without their own thoracic surgeon decide about surgery without one today.
effect_summary_en: An English observational study (Lau et al. 2013) found a 20.0% resection rate in hospitals where surgeons were based against 11.6% in peripheral hospitals; the abstract read does not show the 14.4% vs 12.0% figure for surgeon attendance at lung meetings.
supported_en: Lau et al. 2013 (Journal of Thoracic Oncology) found a higher resection rate where thoracic surgeons were based than in peripheral hospitals (20.0% vs 11.6%) in England in 2008.
not_supported_en: The pages read do not show how big the effect of a surgeon's second opinion is (our assumption: 1.2 points), nor whether it would hold in Finland.
in_use_summary_en: The KYS lung cancer care pathway (dated 2021) says a thoracic surgeon attends the weekly KYS lung meeting, but no Siun sote or KYS page says a thoracic surgeon sits in North Karelia's lung meeting or reviews its decisions not to operate.
summary_en: The KYS cancer centre's lung cancer care pathway (2021) describes a weekly meeting with a thoracic surgeon that decides treatment for every lung cancer patient in the KYS pathway, but no page read shows this covers North Karelia (Siun sote); Siun sote's cancer and chest surgery pages say nothing about such a meeting. An English observational study (Lau 2013) found resection rates of 20.0% where surgeons were based vs 11.6% in peripheral hospitals, which points the same way as our assumed effect but does not confirm its size.
unanswered_en: I found no page on how North Karelia's lung meeting is run or whether its patients are discussed in the KYS meeting; Siun sote's lung disease page returned an error (404).
